```{r}
here::i_am("Charm-Prices.Rproj")
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

#now loading the small csv files
```{r}
brent <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "DCOILBRENTEU.csv"), na = c("", "."))
fx    <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "DEXUSEU.csv"), na = c("", "."))

communes <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "v_commune_2025.csv"),
                     col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
mvt      <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "v_mvt_commune_2025.csv"),
                     col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))

filo_raw  <- read_delim(here("data", "raw", "filosofi_2021_data.csv"),
                        col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
filo_meta <- read_delim(here("data", "raw", "filosofi_2021_metadata.csv"),
                        col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
```
